o.text: Equivalent to xatir (“memory”) + -lə. Compare Turkish hatırlamak.
From Classical Persian سیما (sīmā), from Arabic سِيمَاء (sīmāʔ).
Borrowed from Russian бактериология (bakteriologija). By surface analysis, bakterio- + -logiya.
